files.description: Reads a status table and copies the listed patches into a consumer kernel tree. Authoritative for status semantics: PATCH_RULES holds the valid status words, parse_status parses the os/take/skip modifiers, filter_patch_list resolves conflicts and chooses destinations.
Registry of host kernel patches, grouped by kernel version. An unlisted patch is never deployed.
Registry of BMC kernel patches, applied in a separate run via --patch_table. Its Legend section is the written reference for status words and modifiers.
